nobox.final_span:
approved during a sealed hearing Friday in Hennepin County District Court. According to the documents, it seeks access to text messages, photos, videos, and internet browsing history on the two iPhone 6 Plus phones of Officer Mohamed Noor. It also aims to access GPS location logs, emails, and synced photos; as well as photos and videos location-tagged by the devices.
At the time of the shooting, Noor was a rookie on the force, and the names of the other officers were not disclosed.
According to the search warrant, during a court hearing for the police body camera policy on Aug. 4, incidents of the use of force were discussed, and the following is quoted from the file: "After August three officers...were observed to be looking at their cell phones while having force incidents; their conversations and attitudes changed after that time period."
